name: Switch-NeRF
definition: A Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework for large-scale scene modeling where both the gating network and the experts are Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) that learn homogeneous representations.
summary: Switch-NeRF is a large-scale Neural Radiance Field method that uses a Heterogeneous Mixture of Hash Experts to dynamically route 3D points to specialized hash experts for efficient, scalable rendering.
